T0671.title: Dual Governance
T0671.definition: Dual governance requires two mutually constraining governance bodies to approve major decisions.
T0671.description: Dual governance commonly combines token-holder voting with a security council, multisignature committee, or another governance constituency. Major upgrades, fund transfers, and emergency actions must satisfy both authorization paths. It reduces exposure to flash-loan voting takeovers or compromise of one body, but introduces delay, accountability questions, and possible deadlock, requiring explicit veto, emergency, and recovery rules.
T0671.usageExample: The protocol required both a token vote and security-council multisignature approval for contract upgrades.
